nodes.name: When an agent calls the flow

connector.displayName: When an agent calls the flow

parameters.body/query:
let RequestedGuid = base64_decode_tostring("@{base64(triggerOutputs()?['body/text'])}");
dependencies
| where timestamp > ago(30m)
| where name == "InvokeAgent"
| extend CompoundConversationId = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.conversation.id"])
| where CompoundConversationId endswith strcat("_", RequestedGuid)
| top 1 by timestamp desc
| project AgentConversationId = tostring(split(CompoundConversationId, "_")[0])

parameters.body/query:
let MatchedConversationId = "@{variables('AgentConversationId')}";
let ConversationEvents = dependencies
    | where timestamp > ago(90d)
    | extend CompoundConversationId = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.conversation.id"])
    | where CompoundConversationId == MatchedConversationId
    | extend InputMessages = parse_json(tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.input.messages"])), OutputMessages = parse_json(tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.output.messages"]))
    | project Timestamp = timestamp, CompoundConversationId, InputMessages, OutputMessages, AgentName = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.agent.name"]), AgentId = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.agent.id"]), EnvironmentId = tostring(customDimensions["env.id"]), TraceId = operation_Id;
union
    (ConversationEvents
        | mv-expand Message = InputMessages
        | mv-expand Part = Message.parts
        | where tostring(Part.type) == "text" and isnotempty(tostring(Part.content))
        | project Timestamp, Sequence = 0, Role = tostring(Message.role), Content = tostring(Part.content), AgentName, AgentId, EnvironmentId, ConversationId = CompoundConversationId, TraceId),
    (ConversationEvents
        | mv-expand Message = OutputMessages
        | mv-expand Part = Message.parts
        | where tostring(Part.type) == "text" and isnotempty(tostring(Part.content))
        | project Timestamp, Sequence = 1, Role = tostring(Message.role), Content = tostring(Part.content), AgentName, AgentId, EnvironmentId, ConversationId = CompoundConversationId, TraceId)
| order by Timestamp asc, Sequence asc
| project Timestamp, Role, Content, AgentName, AgentId, EnvironmentId, ConversationId, TraceId
